properties.name: wallet.rp.id
properties.description: WebAuthn Relying Party ID. Must match the registered domain in production (e.g., wpb.diswallet.eu).

properties.name: wallet.rp.name
properties.description: Human-readable name of the Relying Party shown during WebAuthn ceremonies.

properties.name: wallet.origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed WebAuthn origins. Use HTTPS only in production.

properties.name: wallet.allow-untrusted-attestation
properties.description: Allow unverified authenticator attestation. Must be false in production with MDS configured.

properties.name: wallet.challenge.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Time-to-live in seconds for a WebAuthn challenge before it expires.

properties.name: wallet.disclosures.encryption-key
properties.description: Base64-encoded AES-256 key used to encrypt SD-JWT disclosures at rest.

properties.name: wpb.hsm.library
properties.description: Path to the PKCS#11 library file used by the HSM (e.g., /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so).

properties.name: wpb.hsm.pin
properties.description: PIN code for HSM authentication. Should be externalized via environment variable HSM_PIN in production.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.demo-mode
properties.description: Enables demo-only OpenID4VP fallback paths for the local verifier emulator. Never enable in production.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.trust.allowed-client-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of accepted verifier client_id values. When empty, trust validation is permissive (Phase 1 baseline only).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vp.session.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Presentation session time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.demo-mode
properties.description: Activates the in-process simulated OID4VCI adapter. Disable for real SDK integration.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.session-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Issuance session time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.trust.allowed-issuer-ids
properties.description: Comma-separated allow-list of credential issuer identifiers.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.policy.allow-mdoc
properties.description: Allow mso_mdoc credential configurations (deferred to Phase 7).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.simulator.always-defer
properties.description: Force every simulated credential request into a deferred outcome.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.simulator.deferred-polls-before-issue
properties.description: Number of deferred polls before the simulator returns issued credentials.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.credential-issuer-id
properties.description: Hint for the credential issuer identifier when the real SDK adapter is active.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.dpop-mode
properties.description: DPoP support mode: supported | required | disabled.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.metadata-policy
properties.description: Issuer metadata policy: preferSigned | requireSigned | ignoreSigned.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.pkce-required
properties.description: Enforce PKCE for authorization-code grants (always true).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.sdk.use-par-when-supported
properties.description: Send authorization requests via PAR when the issuer advertises it.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.enabled
properties.description: Enable WIA sub-context processing in issuance flows.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.token-ttl-seconds
properties.description: WIA JWT technical TTL in seconds (must remain under 24 hours).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.min-status-maintenance-days
properties.description: Minimum client_status maintenance period in days.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.reuse-per-issuer
properties.description: Reuse WIA status list entry per issuer (default false for privacy).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-name
properties.description: Wallet solution name claim included in WIA.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-version
properties.description: Wallet solution version claim included in WIA.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-link
properties.description: Optional URI with further wallet solution information.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.wallet-solution-certification-information
properties.description: Certification information claim for the wallet solution.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.signing-x5c
properties.description: Optional raw x5c value embedded in WIA header (MVP transport only).

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.max-nonce-mismatch-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries when authorization fails due to nonce mismatch.

properties.name: wpb.openid4vci.wia.max-expired-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries when WIA is expired during authorization.
